mapper.select:
select a.id as articleId, a.title as title, t.action_type as actionType, t.action_time as actionTime from (
select article_id, 'liked' as action_type, create_time as action_time from article_like where user_id = #{userId} and create_time >= timestampadd(day, -#{days}, now()) union all
select article_id, 'collected' as action_type, create_time as action_time from article_collect where user_id = #{userId} and create_time >= timestampadd(day, -#{days}, now()) union all
) t join article a on a.id = t.article_id order by t.action_time desc
